input.quote: Section 10.13 Intent of the Parties; Reasonableness. The Depositor, the Servicer and the Issuer acknowledge and agree that the purpose of Sections 6.6 and 6.7 of this Agreement is to facilitate compliance by the Issuer and the Depositor with the provisions of Regulation AB
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant of any kind. The only insurance references are Obligor insurance premiums billed to wireless accounts (p0095) and FDIC deposit insurance in the \"Qualified Institution\" definition (p0903); neither is a Servicer coverage obligation. Cellco, as Servicer and Custodian, services the Receivables and handles Obligor account and payment information, so the absence of coverage sits in walk-away territory. Article X (Miscellaneous) ends at Section 10.13, so we inserted a new Section 10.14 carrying only the fallback levels (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000). We selected the fallback rather than the preferred CGL/E&O/cyber/workers' compensation/certificates package as the shortest complete cure appropriate to this financing document.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

proposal.summary: Insert a short insurance covenant (E&O USD 1,000,000; cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000) as new Section 10.14 in Article X (Miscellaneous).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant even though the Servicer services the Receivables and handles Obligor account information, so we added our fallback coverage levels: errors and omissions of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: Insurance. The Servicer will maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than $1,000,000 and cyber liability and privacy insurance of not less than $2,000,000.
